summary: 43 units checked word by word. Splits and text_flags are sound (all typo conjectures plausible, src kept as printed). Main errors: wrong gender for yoni (u90, 126); contradictory case label on bahuvrīhi members (u87); supplied noun रक्त in Hindi 92; 'फिर भी' for punar api (u98); anyatame mistranslated as 'one of the two' (u94, needs human); sibling inconsistency yoni (womb)/fertile season vs yoni (vagina)/ṛtu (season); conjectural readings in 98/99 unmarked in translation; missed darbha identification; missed possible conjecture śūdrāyās tu for śuddhāyāstu (u111, human). Sentences running across units: 87-88, 89-90, 91-92, 98-99-100, 100-101, 107-108, 110-111, 112-113, 117-119; no regrouping needed.
glossary_suggestions: ṛtu = 'ṛtu (season)' (twelve nights from ārtava seen, ch01 u83); not 'fertile season'.
punar api in Hindi = फिर से (never फिर भी).
cintayati, varjayati, pīḍayati are 10th-class verbs; do not label 'caus.' in gram.
yava = यव also in compound explanations (yāvaka).
darbha = kuśa-type grass, Desmostachya bipinnata (disputed; Imperata cylindrica also given).
anyatama = one of several (3+), not 'one of the two'.
bīja in conception contexts = probably semen; hedge and gloss बीज यानी सम्भवतः शुक्र.
